name: skills
title_zh: 从零搭企业级 .NET 微服务与多智能体的工程手册
tagline_zh: 装它，等于把微软 MVP 的完整工程决策链搬进终端——从 ASP.NET Core 分层到 Azure OpenA…
tagline_en: Stop guessing enterprise .NET. Get a terminal-installed playbook with battle-tested code for microservices, Azure.
desc_en: Complete engineering playbook and agent skills for building enterprise ASP.NET Core solutions, distributed microservices, and autonomous Azure OpenAI / MAF multi-agent systems via npx skills add
why_zh: 不是零散博客，而是按真实交付顺序组织的技能集：先定架构边界，再落分布式模式。
why_en: Unlike scattered blog posts, this is a delivery-ordered skill set: architecture boundaries → distributed patterns → autonomous.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 .NET 8+ 与 Azure 生态；不含本地开发环境搭建、数据库选型对比、前端界面代码。
limit_en: .NET 8+ & Azure only. No local env setup, DB comparisons, or frontend. Outputs compile-ready skeletons/patterns, not full apps. Azure subscription.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
